comparison.objective: Draw down a manikin eyelid and dispense exactly one eye drop without contact; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate compliant contact, dropper aiming, and squeeze-dose control versus rigid two-tool alignment and rotational counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Requires one correctly landed drop, no contamination or excessive force, bottle return, and lid recovery; candidate requires a retained 90° stop over three cycles.
comparison.reason: The medical dosing and non-contact precision ability has no meaningful mechanism or outcome overlap with screw-and-locknut adjustment.
